capabilities: Sync vault notes and attachments across devices through an ATProto PDS
Encrypt notes, attachments, filenames, and titles end-to-end with a passphrase-derived key
Merge edits with three-way, character-level merging and keep losing versions in Sync Conflicts/
Publish individual notes as public plaintext records with embedded images
Sync a plain vault folder via the atpsync CLI and daemon without Obsidian
extras: Companion CLI/daemon (atpsync) and MCP interface ship in the repo; a public web viewer for published notes is planned at notesky.app. Files over the PDS blob limit (~5 MB) stay local-only, and losing the encryption passphrase makes server-side notes unrecoverable.
problem: Syncing a vault across devices normally relies on Obsidian's own Sync service or third-party servers; this plugin instead stores notes as encrypted records in the user's own ATProto PDS repo.

relations.evidence: character-level merging (the same algorithm Obsidian Sync uses)
sign in with Bluesky (OAuth) or with an app password

requires.name: Bluesky or other ATProto PDS account

summary: End-to-end encrypted vault sync to your own ATProto PDS (Bluesky, Blacksky, Eurosky, or self-hosted), with per-note public publishing.
